title: Fix typos and unclear sentences in the Session 1 notes
body:
## Problem
The Session 1 notes may contain typos or sentences that a first-year student finds confusing, especially about logarithms and pH.

## Context
Beginners judge the whole repo by Session 1.

## Expected outcome
A clearer `sessions/session-01/README.md` and `lesson.py` comments.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`, `sessions/session-01/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] At least three improvements
- [ ] `python start.py test` still passes

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Add more solutions to the pH scale figure
body:
## Problem
The pH scale figure only shows strong acids, strong bases and water.

## Context
Students ask where lemon juice, vinegar or soap fit on the scale.

## Expected outcome
A figure that adds at least four everyday liquids with approximate pH values and a note that they are typical ranges, not exact values.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Values are labelled approximate with a source named in a comment
- [ ] The figure is readable on a phone

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Add a colour-blind-safe flask colour option to the live apps
body:
## Problem
The flask colour in the apps relies on red-green hues that some users cannot tell apart.

## Context
Accessibility is part of the quality checklist (QUALITY.md, item 9).

## Expected outcome
A colour map that stays distinguishable for common types of colour-blindness, plus the pH printed in the flask.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/app.html`, `sessions/session-02/app.html`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Flask colours distinguishable in grayscale
- [ ] Screenshot added to the pull request

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Add Session 4: fit the titration curve
body:
## Problem
The roadmap's first milestone does not exist yet.

## Context
See `promo/roadmap.md`. The shipped code only reads the derivative peak; fitting the whole curve uses all the data.

## Expected outcome
`sessions/session-04/` with README (sections A to F), lesson, checkpoint, exercises and app in the same style as Sessions 1 to 3.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`, `sessions/session-03/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Checkpoint prints PASS and the roadmap checkpoint is met
- [ ] Added to the tests

## Difficulty
intermediate

title: Add a diprotic acid to the solver
body:
## Problem
The solver handles one weak acid only.

## Context
Roadmap milestone 3. A diprotic acid has two dissociation constants and two jumps.

## Expected outcome
A charge-balance function with two Ka values, a figure with two buffer regions and a checkpoint.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-03/lesson.py`, `promo/roadmap.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Second equivalence volume is twice the first within 0.5 percent
- [ ] Bisection bracket reasoning explained in a comment

## Difficulty
intermediate

title: Reproduce the Target: a live burette titration animation
body:
## Problem
The Target animation shows a burette, a colour-changing flask, a live pH curve and the derivative peak; there is no public implementation.

## Context
The code behind the Target is private on purpose. The roadmap gives the path.

## Expected outcome
Your own implementation, written from the roadmap, plus an animation like the Target.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Animation of at most 60 frames and 3 MB whose last frame reports the equivalence volume within 0.1 mL
- [ ] Short write-up of your method

## Difficulty
advanced

title: Translate the Session 1 notes into Hindi
body:
## Problem
Students who prefer Hindi cannot read Session 1 comfortably.

## Context
This project teaches first- and second-year students across India; translations widen who can join.

## Expected outcome
`sessions/session-01/README.hi.md` with a faithful Hindi translation of sections A to F, linked from the main README.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] All sections translated
- [ ] Equations, code blocks and file names unchanged
- [ ] Link added to the main README

## Difficulty
beginner
